project.name: Quantum Energy Venture Lab
project.summary: Evidence-first research and engineering on programmable open-quantum transport and adjacent energy/materials systems, with explicit uncertainty, conventional controls, reproducible code, and public correction history.

established: Open quantum systems can exhibit environment-assisted transport in appropriate regimes.
Exciton, charge-transfer, cavity, morphology, electrostatic, contact, thermal, and measurement effects can all influence energy/materials devices and must be discriminated experimentally.
The repository contains open calculations, synthetic benchmarks, metrology protocols, evidence notes, and engineering specifications.
not_established: A unique quantum explanation for every observed transport or photovoltaic effect.
Commercially superior power conversion or lifetime from the current research program.
